svg.text: AMBI — REAL-TIME AI SALES COPILOT · SECURITY ARCHITECTURE
⬡ Token Storage: access_token + refresh_token persisted in browser IndexedDB/localStorage by Supabase SDK · Supabase auto-rotates on expiry
DB reads/writes · RLS-gated · public by design
Bot management · never sent to browser
Admin DB access · bypasses RLS · server only
Full doc text · pgvector embeddings · metadata
User identity · group membership · RLS enforced
⟳ Incremental Sync: After first run, Drive Changes API returns only new/modified files via changes_page_token stored in group_integrations. Token auto-refreshed if expiring within 5 min.
Content capped at 8,000 chars/file · Unsupported types (PDF, binary) skipped · 200-file limit per sync run · Vercel 60s timeout boundary
Returns top-5 docs · fetches full content
Browser polls GET /api/recall/transcript/:botId every 1500ms · cursor-based pagination
All client queries filtered by auth.uid() membership in group_members table
Server-side Bearer Token Validation (Drive sync API)
POST /api/integrations/google-drive/sync validates JWT against Supabase /auth/v1/user before access
Runs with elevated privileges on auth.users INSERT · writes to public.profiles safely bypassing RLS
RPC filters by target_group_id · similarity threshold 0.5 · returns top-5 matching docs
RLS-protected DB — group_documents · group_integrations · profiles · meeting_sessions
Ephemeral (Redis 4h TTL) — Raw transcript events keyed by bot UUID
TLS in transit — All external API calls use HTTPS (OpenAI · Supabase · Google · Recall.ai · Upstash)
